transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We're happy with our internet service, but our phone and security systems are with different vendors. Billing is becoming a nightmare.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I understand that frustration. Managing multiple vendors is time-consuming and often more expensive. Let me show you our integrated bundle that could simplify your operations and reduce costs.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: What kind of savings are we talking about? We're currently spending about $800 on phones and $400 on security separately.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: With our complete bundle, you'd pay $2,100 total monthly instead of your current $3,000 across three vendors. That's $900 monthly savings plus simplified billing and unified support.
